resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register dates construction 1973-77, and firelookout.com says it began in 1973 and was not finished until 1977. Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1977 as the build year. The record's 1973 is the start of construction.
Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 2011 for addition to the register; the register's own page gives September 27, 2020, which the record uses.

notes_for_editor: Medium confidence. Elevation: the register gives 9,170 ft; firelookout.com gives 9167 ft, and the record keeps the register figure. The 2011 register date on Idaho Fire Lookouts contradicts the register's 2020 date. The 1981 'Emergency Status' entry is unexplained and is used only as a timeline line. No source describes public access beyond the drive-up label; the building is in radio use. No staffing history was found after completion, so no staffing fact is recorded.
